svg.title: Fraud clusters found in 500 synthetic claims
svg.desc: 58 fraud clusters from the seeded demo program, drawn as small stars grouped by kind: same photo 14, same address 13, same serial 17, same payout 14. Each star has a center marker for the shared photo, address, serial, or payout destination and one dot per member claim. 117 memberships across 117 distinct claims.
svg.text: Fraud clusters found in 500 synthetic claims
Connected components in the Neo4j projection; members are claims, centers are the shared photo, address, serial, or payout destination
claim joined to the value it shares; the marker's shape and color name the kind
58 clusters covering 117 of the 500 claims. Source: fraud_clusters for the seeded demo program (make seed)
